config.description: Discrete de Rham benchmark on curvilinear cubical meshes. See ASSUMPTIONS.md.

notes.epistemic_status: All entries under 'algebraic_residuals', 'betti', 'kernel_num', 'geometry' and 'spectra' are direct numerical observations on the discrete level. Convergence of eigenvalues with h is reported as an indicator only; it is NOT evidence of Mosco convergence of the underlying bilinear forms.
